newsitem.title: GERMANY: Most German coffee roasters plan price hikes.
newsitem.headline: Most German coffee roasters plan price hikes.

text.p: Most German coffee roasters were planning retail price increases or had made firm decisions to follow market leader Kraft Jacobs Suchard's announcement earlier today, they told Reuters.
Melitta Kaffee GmbH and Alois Dallmayr Kaffee oHG officials said they would raise prices per kilo of roasted coffee by two marks as of March 10, as KJS did.
Tchibo Frisch-Roest Kaffee GmbH said it would raise its prices at the end of February but would not say by how much.
J. J. Darboven said it was thinking along the lines of the KJS move but top management had not yet confirmed details.
Eduscho GmbH & Co KG said it had recently raised the price of one of its key brand by the same amount and would await further developments.
The roasters cited higher raw materials prices and a firmer dollar.
